requirement: Tracy Business: the call to action inside a band the template keeps (WordPress, Joomla) and on a band painted with a worn colour (EmDash) wears the system's button pair, checked against that band's ground

oracle.ref: PR #1134 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-kept-buttons-2026-10-11/README.md (flow.mjs on a local WordPress and Joomla Tracy Business stand and on the stand's EmDash site dsbtnem01, 10 systems each); tasks/evidence/ds-walkthrough-2026-10-11/README.md note 12.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'Tracy Business: the call to action inside a kept band wears the system, judged on the band's ground' passes: on wordpress-tracy-business and joomla-tracy-business, under Spotify and Stripe, every keptButtons band has a rule painting its buttons with the system's accent and accent-on (fill on the band >= 3:1, text on the fill >= 4.5:1) and a hover rule, judged on the ground the band shows: the system's own where bands.mjs makes the band wear it (#1258, 12/10/2026), else the band's kept ground. 'kept-band buttons: the pair turns over or stays the template's when the accent cannot stand out on the band' passes: a black accent on an ink band turns over (white fill, black text); a pair neither colour of which stands out keeps the template's button; a band outside keepScopes, or a selector that could leave its rule, writes nothing. 'EmDash Tracy Business: the call to action on a painted band stands out from that band under every system' passes for Apple, Stripe, Spotify, Linear, Binance, Superhuman, Editorial, Mintlify, Ferrari and Runway: .band-ink (ground fg) and .bg-forest (ground accent-text) buttons stand >= 3:1 on their band with text >= 4.5:1; Apple's forest-band button is white with blue text. 'a band selector or button selector that could leave its rule is never written' passes.
